scope: The measured height_boundary_points counter covers delegated height queries and explicit flat-adapter boundary calls; it is not a complete nested interface-method count.
derivation: Double the measured query count to enclose the delegated geometry adapters, then reserve front and two boundary-interface methods for every closed launch. Instrumentation wrappers are not additional numerical evaluations.
chronology: Post-run accounting supplement derived from the unchanged fixed fixture and solver limits; not an as-run nested method counter.
